fields.title: Digital Photography Masterclass: From Beginner to Pro
fields.description: A comprehensive guide to mastering digital photography, covering camera settings, composition, lighting, and post-processing techniques.
fields.short_description: Learn professional photography skills from camera basics to advanced editing techniques.
fields.requirements: A digital camera (DSLR or mirrorless), basic computer skills
fields.learning_outcomes: Master camera settings, understand composition rules, learn lighting techniques, edit photos professionally, build a photography portfolio
fields.who_can_join: Anyone interested in photography, no prior experience needed

fields.title: Outdoor Photography & Nature Journaling
fields.description: Combine photography and journaling to document outdoor adventures, wildlife, and natural landscapes.
fields.short_description: Capture nature's beauty through photography and reflective journaling.
fields.requirements: Camera or smartphone, notebook, interest in nature
fields.learning_outcomes: Master outdoor photography techniques, document wildlife and landscapes, create nature journals, develop observational skills, combine visual and written documentation

fields.target_audience: Aspiring authors, content creators, small business owners

fields.learning_outcomes: Identify personal style archetypes, build capsule wardrobes, mix and match clothing effectively, understand color theory for fashion, shop strategically

fields.title: Skincare Science: Building Your Perfect Routine

fields.who_can_join: Adults interested in skincare science and product formulation
